digest.component_or_area: MCP server tool registration and documentation
propositions: MCP reference documentation must be auto-generated from live registrars with tools classified deterministically into three gate tiers: Read-only (always available), LLM-gated (REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM), and Write-gated (REBAR_MCP_READONLY).

Generator must enumerate all three registrars with REBAR_MCP_READONLY=0 to capture all 47 tools (23 read + 6 llm + 18 write) and apply a closed 4-entry special-case override table for hybrid-gated tools (reconcile, fsck, sign_review, run_workflow).

Four special-case tools require inline annotations: reconcile (read-only, requires both REBAR_MCP_READONLY and REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_JIRA_SYNC for live modes), fsck (readonly-recover path gated), sign_review (write-gated hybrid in LLM registrar), run_workflow (write-gated, with LLM workflows additionally requiring REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM).
Drift detection must fail CI if the generated reference drifts from live registrars, wired into both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml with parity enforced by test_ci_workflow_parity.py.

Generated documentation must be structurally separated by gate tier with section headings, list all tools with first-line summaries, include MCP_ENV_VARS gate descriptions, and pass deterministic section-bounded and count assertions.
